reversePrd: This project is a premium website landing page and design planning tool for SBA, a security systems installer in Aktau, Kazakhstan. It features service outlines, local currency interactive cost estimation quiz, customer review submission forms, local-first database sync, and a detailed client/admin dashboard utilizing an interactive Konva-based layout blueprint tool for cameras, fire detectors, and networking systems.
